directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: find-a-spoken-passage-in-word-times: a film's word-timed span finder, moved byte for byte

preserve: span: words compared lower-case with everything but letters, digits and apostrophes removed; the last words searched from the first match; the printed start, end and text
sentences: a sentence ends at a word ending in . ? or !; an unfinished last one prints with no end
words_home: a words list kept as it is, Whisper segments turned into {text, start, end}, the file {source, timing, words}
allowed_deltas: one JSON request with a step; a clip read from the words_folder setting (the person's list:settings row)
sentences reads Whisper segments too (the old one raised KeyError)
the {t, start, end} words of tools/audio-transcription read; an offset and rounding when writing a words file
banned_substitutions: a person's transcript folder written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
